feeds.title: Aerospace Unplugged
feeds.description: The Aerospace industry is ready for takeoff and Honeywell Aerospace is here to keep you up to date with interviews featuring special guests, industry experts talking about technology breakthroughs, emerging trends and more. So, if you work in the industry, are passionate about the ins and outs of the aerospace world or just want to know how Honeywell solutions help take the industry to new heights this is the podcast for you.
